verdict.rationale: Evidence clearly shows llama.cpp supports LLM inference (cli/serve) and multimodal/vision models (VLM session, Gemma-3 image support confirmed working by users), plus broad hardware/quantization support suggesting wide architecture coverage. However, there is no direct evidence pack mention of embedding models, MoE-specific architectures, or the breadth ('hundreds') of supported model families, so the claim is only partially substantiated.
